text:
sarah (AE): Hi team — CorpZero wants a private deployment POC. They need: interface-style VPC endpoint access from their VPC, firewall allowlist rules we can hand to their netops, and clarity on pricing (reserved vs burst). Target POC window: 2 weeks starting next Tues. Can we confirm gaps?
lee (CorpZero CTO): Yep. Main asks: preserve originating client IP for our logs, outbound egress control, and proof of audit/KMS integration. Pricing: must fit a 6k USD/month budget for the pilot if possible.
miguel (NetOps): Quick Q — connecting via AWS Direct Connect to their spoke VPC, or are they in multiple accounts? That affects whether we recommend an interface endpoint per VPC or a TGW-fronted solution.
anya (Solutions Eng): Recos: for single-account/single-spoke -> VPC Interface Endpoint (PrivateLink) to our NLB. For multi-account, either shared VPC endpoints or put Redwood behind their TGW with route propagation. Preserving client IP: we can preserve source IP if traffic enters our service via a L3-preserving path (no SNAT at the connector). If they NAT at their egress, we lose it.
ravi (Security): Security checklist — we need to confirm: KMS key wrapping for customer data, audit log forwarding (CloudTrail/Flow logs), and whether they need HSM-backed keys (enterprise). Also confirm their CISO will accept our SOC2 + PenTest report.
sarah (AE): Miguel/Anya, can you draft the minimal firewall snippet and route table changes we can give to customer netops? Keep it minimal: ports, FQDNs/IPs, SNI note.
miguel (NetOps): Snippet — allow outbound from corp subnet to Redwood NLB IPs on 443 + health-check ports. If using PrivateLink, no internet egress required. Example ACL: 
```
# Security group on their side (example)
Type: Outbound
Protocol: TCP
Port: 443
Destination: vpce-<redwood-vpce>.svc.amazonaws.com OR 10.0.5.54/32 (NLB IPs)
Description: Allow to Redwood inference endpoint (HTTPS)
```
Also add route table: point 10.0.0.0/8 -> interface endpoint ENI for that AZ, or TGW route to shared service VPC.
anya (Solutions Eng): Test curl to validate path (from inside their subnet):
```
curl -v --resolve api.redwood.local:443:10.0.5.54 https://api.redwood.local/v1/health
```
If the client IP in our logs shows their original private IP, preservation is confirmed. If it shows NATed address, ask their netops to disable source NAT for that flow.
sarah (AE): Pricing note for sales — for the POC we can offer a short-term reserved pool discount (20%) plus a cap on network egress billing for 30 days. Miguel, how much capacity to reserve for a small pilot (100 concurrent LLM sessions, typical seq len 512)?
miguel (NetOps): For 100 concurrent at seq=512, estimate ~2 x our medium GPU slice (conservative). Recommend reserving a single small Dedicated pool to hit latency SLOs. I can run a quick perf sim and give numbers by EOD.
ravi (Security): On questionnaires: we can produce a redwood security addendum + a short answers doc for KMS/HSM + sample CI/CD audit extract. I will prepare a two-page doc for the customer team.
deploy-bot: Runbook created: https://console.redwood.internal/runbooks/corpzero-poc (contains endpoint names, NLB IPs, and test vectors). Auto-generated preflight checklist attached. :white_check_mark:
sarah (AE): Great. Action items: miguel -> perf numbers and firewall snippet consolidation; anya -> endpoint creation steps + exact FQDN/IP list; ravi -> 2-pg security addendum; i will send PO for the pilot discount. Can we get everything by Monday EOD?
lee (CorpZero CTO): Monday EOD works. Also: any special hostnames we need to allow in proxy (they run an outbound proxy)? If so we need FQDNs, not IPs.
anya (Solutions Eng): If they use an outbound proxy that does TLS interception, we need their proxy to allow SNI passthrough or a TLS bypass to the endpoint. We will provide FQDNs: [api.redwood.corpzero.redwood-inference.com] and short-lived NLB IPs for the POC.
miguel (NetOps): One more operational note: health-checks require ephemeral ports 1024-65535 if they use stateful firewall tracking. Recommend allowing ephemeral responses from the endpoint, or disable strict ephemeral filtering for the subnet.
sarah (AE): Perfect — I'll consolidate and send the handoff doc to CorpZero netops + security. Ping me if anything blocks the Monday EOD delivery. :+1:
